description: Simulation Dataset for Load and Dispatchable Generation Control in a Renewable-Dominated Residential Microgrid is a data set deposited in ardcx.cqu by its authors Anindita Troyee, Biplob Ray (Central Queensland University). This dataset contains simulation-based research data generated for a Master of Research thesis on coordinated load and dispatchable generation control in a renewable-dominated residential microgrid. The dataset includes DIgSILENT PowerFactory microgrid model files, MATLAB/Python analysis files, Excel-based load, tariff, optimisation and performance datasets, thesis figures, simulation plots, and final documentation files. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 152994072 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
